verificationSummary: Editor merge commit 2538c2af02f2bda7aa6eafb8d621eec33bc28cc0 implements the bounded creator Structure panel add-affordance foundation for the Editor left panel. OutlinePanel now exposes the left landmark as Document structure, labels the panel Structure, renders Structure summary wording, shows a disabled append Add block affordance in the panel header, shows one disabled selected-row Add block affordance after the selected Outline item, exposes data-outline-add-state disabled plus append/after placement markers, keeps Authoring limited visible, preserves the existing onSelectNode selection path, and changes summary type counting to a single pass. Focused RED first failed in src/tests/outlineScannability.test.ts because the Structure summary, disabled add state, large-outline item-count marker, and bounded add source marker were absent. Follow-up RED failed because the panel landmark still said Document outline instead of Document structure. Focused GREEN passed npx vitest run src/tests/outlineScannability.test.ts --reporter verbose with 1 file and 4 tests. The large-structure synthetic test renders 1200 Outline items and asserts exactly one selected-row add affordance instead of one per row. Editor worktree npm run check passed type-check, 90 passed test files, 312 passed tests, and build. Worktree browser evidence in live Backend mode passed FLOWDOC_EVIDENCE_WRITE=0 npm run evidence:editor-browser-live-backend-smoke and retained editor-browser-live-backend-smoke-v1: summary-columns > title > detail-table. Merged Editor main npm run check passed type-check, 90 passed test files, 312 passed tests, and build. Main browser evidence in live Backend mode passed FLOWDOC_EVIDENCE_WRITE=0 npm run evidence:editor-browser-live-backend-smoke and retained editor-browser-live-backend-smoke-v1: summary-columns > title > detail-table. Vite still reports the existing chunk-size warning. Editor npm install in the lane still reported 5 high severity vulnerabilities. Project Control baseline npm run check passed check:data, type-check, 57 test files, 328 tests, build, and 6 e2e tests before record edits. Project Control focused record tests passed 3 files and 4 tests after the new lane test and expected Work lists were added. Project Control record gate npm run check passed check:data, type-check, 58 passed test files, 329 passed tests, build, and 6 e2e tests after records and tests were added. git deregistered the Editor worktree and branch deletion succeeded, but the residual .worktrees/editor-creator-structure-add-affordance-foundation folder could not be removed because a verified recursive cleanup command was rejected by local command policy. Previous residual Editor worktree folders for editor-inspector-detail-navigation-foundation, editor-outline-scannability-foundation, and editor-selection-context-summary-foundation remain local cleanup risks. This evidence supports only the bounded Editor Structure panel add-affordance presentation layer and synthetic large-structure affordance-count guard. It does not promote broad Editor truth, WYSIWYG readiness, text input readiness, active add-block creation, command authoring readiness, Backend mutation or persistence readiness, Backend production readiness, Core truth, real large-document authoring performance readiness, accessibility readiness, visual regression readiness, durable storage readiness, PDF export readiness, bundle-size readiness, live production behavior, or FlowDoc product readiness.
